summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of independent director Liu Wen Tao effective August 24, 2026, with no disagreement stated. Concurrently, the board appointed Chan Chee Leong as independent director and compensation committee chair, and Tan Kwang Leng as CFO, effective the same date. Agus Prasetyo stepped down as acting CFO but remains chairman and CEO. Compensation terms: Chan receives US$10,000 annually; Tan receives US$3,000 monthly. These are routine, non-forced governance transitions, with no special-situation structural elements, deal terms, or strategic implications disclosed.
